# foreman_smartproxy (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_smartproxy" "dc1_proxy" {
  name = "proxy.dc1.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the smartproxy to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `location_ids` (Set of Number) REPLACE locations with given ids
- `organization_ids` (Set of Number) REPLACE organizations with given ids.
- `url` (String)
